goal: One real same-phrase, author-endorsed redesign heldout from visual scoring; check if our criteria rank the better source-design candidate without reading the source chronology during the vote.

source.title: 坤哥改字 | 那些年，在字体设计上犯的错！
source.source_stage: Original submitted wordmark vs author's corrected design
source.selector: Web article main body image elements at DOM original image indexes 22 and 23, each observed 600x400 natural pixels
source.author_claim: Author personally identifies original and modified, but this is self-reported choice and not independent blind design quality

mask_protocol.display: A/B anonymous same-size side-by-side source panels; randomly swap original and revised image positions inside browser without returning the mapping until analysis frozen.
mask_protocol.information_leakage: The source page context indicates before/after chronology; evaluator may guess with visual clues. One reviewer is the model itself, thus not independent. Label it partial blind or label-masked, NOT scientifically controlled double blind.
preregister_criteria: text_identity: 0/1; first verify same Chinese text and no wrong component, if fails rank invalid
readability_at_native_and_50_percent: 0..4, look at actual glyph structure not style preference
stroke_weight_coherence: 0..4, assess interiors and wordmark consistency
negative_space_and_balance: 0..4, individual counterspace plus whole phrase
distinctive_authored_identity: 0..4, not just generic font or added unrelated flourish
application_fit: 0..4, first ignore frame/layout differences when possible
mask_protocol.score_formula: Any invalid glyph is disqualified. Otherwise five quality items scored 0-4 (20 total). Only decisive when difference>=3 AND no glyph corruption. Must document why by character-specific observations, not only numerical impression.

sample_budget: one pair, no reselect after seeing or losing
reveal: After pre-reveal ranking and reasons committed, reveal site original/final captions and compare with author decision. No retroactive rubric edits.
conclusion_boundary: A match to author preference on one case is calibration only, not evidence of general aesthetic skill. Failure/disagreement must be preserved; no sample cherry picking.
author_source_copyright: Only links to public source images; no public re-host of article images.
